sections.text_ja_canonical: 体の時計が、光や決まった生活時間とどのように関係するのかに注目して聞いてください。

sections.source_en:
Sometimes, a person opens their eyes just before the alarm rings.

It can feel like a small mystery. Did the body know the time?

The human body has a built-in clock. Light helps this clock match the twenty-four-hour day. Regular sleep and wake times can also help. In a laboratory study, weak light and regular routines usually matched a twenty-four-hour day. They did not usually match shorter or longer days.

sections.text_ja_canonical: ここまでで、体内時計は光や決まった生活リズムに合わせて動くことが分かりました。では、外から合図がなくても、決めた時間近くに起きられることはあるのでしょうか。

sections.source_en: Researchers also study a related ability called self-awakening: waking near a planned time without an outside signal. A review found many studies involving hundreds of people. But the studies used different rules. In many of them, waking within 30 minutes of the planned time counted as success. So, the body may prepare for an expected waking time. But research does not yet show that the body can predict the exact moment an alarm will ring.

sections.text_ja_canonical: 体には、明るさや毎日の生活リズムに合わせて動く時計があります。研究では、決まった時刻の近くに自然に目を覚ますことが調べられていますが、アラームが鳴る正確な瞬間まで分かるとは、まだ言えません。ここからは、目覚めの準備が進む順番と、眠りの最後の段階に注目します。

sections.source_en: The body may prepare in stages

The preparation does not seem to be one sudden event. In one study, a hormone called ACTH rose about one hour before waking when people expected sleep to end. In another, activity in the front-right part of the brain changed about 30 minutes before successful self-awakening. In a short nap study, heart rate began to rise about 3 minutes before waking. Together, these findings suggest a slow build-up toward waking. A person may become physically ready before becoming fully conscious.

The body's preparation is only part of the story. Near the end of a normal night, deep sleep becomes less common, while lighter sleep and dream sleep become more common. Waking from deep sleep is linked with stronger grogginess than waking from lighter sleep. This may help explain why one morning feels easy, while another feels much harder.

sections.text_ja_canonical: ここまで、目覚めに向かう体の変化と、目覚める前の睡眠の段階について見てきました。この二つを合わせると、起きるまでの流れと、起きたときの感じ方の両方に目を向けられます。では、英語でまとめを聞いてみましょう。

sections.source_en: Waking before an alarm may be a gradual preparation meeting the right sleep stage—not proof of a perfect inner timekeeper.
